scispell.name: SciSPELL
scispell.subtitle: Science Spelling Bee
scispell.tagline: Spell Science. Know Science. Master Science.
scispell.pillarBlurb: Making science terminology exciting and accessible.
scispell.shortDescription: Making scientific vocabulary exciting and memorable.
description: SciSPELL — Science Spelling Bee is an innovative academic competition designed to make science learning more engaging, memorable and exciting.
The programme challenges students to demonstrate their knowledge of scientific terminology while developing vocabulary, confidence, concentration and a deeper appreciation of science.
SciSPELL transforms scientific terms that students often encounter in textbooks and classrooms into an exciting competitive learning experience.
objectives: Promote interest in science among young learners.
Improve students' understanding of scientific terminology.
Develop confidence and communication skills.
Encourage healthy academic competition.
Make science learning fun and engaging.
Help students develop stronger scientific vocabulary.
scispell.eligibility: Students who meet the eligibility requirements for each edition of the competition.
scispell.format: School rounds → Regional finals → Grand finale

code-africa.name: Code Africa
code-africa.subtitle: A Pan-African Coding Competition for Schools
code-africa.pillarBlurb: Equipping young Africans to become creators with technology.
code-africa.shortDescription: Connecting schools and young coders across Africa.
description: Code Africa is a pan-African coding competition designed for schools across Africa.
The competition provides young learners with an opportunity to demonstrate their coding and computational thinking abilities while competing with students from different schools and countries.
Code Africa seeks to move young people beyond simply using technology to becoming creators and problem-solvers through technology.
objectives: Promote coding and computational thinking.
Encourage technology education in African schools.
Identify and nurture young coding talents.
Develop problem-solving and logical reasoning skills.
Encourage innovation among young people.
Connect learners across African countries through technology.
code-africa.eligibility: Schools and eligible students from participating African countries.
code-africa.imageAlt: Students coding on computers in a lab

stem-kids-championship.name: STEM Kids Championship
stem-kids-championship.subtitle: Pan-African STEM Competition
stem-kids-championship.tagline: Where Young Minds Compete, Discover and Excel.
stem-kids-championship.pillarBlurb: Building early interest and excellence in STEM.
stem-kids-championship.shortDescription: Inspiring young learners through STEM competition and excellence.
description: The STEM Kids Championship — Pan-African Edition is a STEM competition designed to provide young learners across Africa with a platform to demonstrate their knowledge, develop confidence and compete in a stimulating academic environment.

Candidates compete in Mathematics, Basic Science and Computer Technology across two categories: Basic 3 – 6 and JSS 1 – 3. The 5th Edition is the International Edition, with the exam holding on November 14, 2026 across selected cities in Africa.

Schools registering 10 candidates or more can take advantage of an early-bird fee of ₦2,000 per candidate. The championship encourages children to develop a strong foundation in STEM while experiencing the excitement of competition and connecting with other young STEM enthusiasts.
objectives: Encourage early interest in STEM.
Promote academic excellence.
Develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Create opportunities for young STEM enthusiasts across Africa.
Encourage healthy academic competition.
Identify and celebrate outstanding young learners.
stem-kids-championship.eligibility: Basic 3 – 6 and JSS 1 – 3 learners in primary and secondary schools across Africa.
stem-kids-championship.imageAlt: STEM Kids Championship winners with their awards

african-organic-chemistry-tournament.name: African Organic Chemistry Tournament
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.subtitle: Interschool Organic Chemistry Olympiad
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.pillarBlurb: Challenging students to achieve excellence in advanced chemistry.
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.shortDescription: Challenging students to think deeply and excel in organic chemistry.
description: The African Organic Chemistry Tournament is an interschool organic chemistry olympiad designed to challenge students' understanding of organic chemistry and encourage excellence in chemical sciences.
The tournament provides a competitive platform for students to apply their knowledge, demonstrate analytical thinking and engage with challenging organic chemistry problems.
It also seeks to inspire students who have an interest in chemistry and encourage them to consider careers in science, engineering, medicine, technology and related fields.
objectives: Promote excellence in organic chemistry.
Encourage deeper understanding of chemical concepts.
Develop analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Identify and celebrate talented chemistry students.
Encourage interest in chemistry-related careers.
Connect schools and students through academic competition.
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.eligibility: Senior secondary students of chemistry, entered through their schools.
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.imageAlt: Students conducting an organic chemistry experiment
african-organic-chemistry-tournament.prizeNote: Star Prize: ₦500,000 cash prize and plaque

primeStemProgrammes.name: Annual National Science Championship
primeStemProgrammes.blurb: A national science championship connecting learners and schools across Nigeria.
description: The Annual National Science Championship (ANSC) is a national science competition designed for learners across Nigeria.
The championship provides students with an opportunity to test their science knowledge, compete with peers from across the country and demonstrate academic excellence.
The programme also provides a platform for identifying, recognising and celebrating outstanding young science learners.

primeStemProgrammes.name: Laptop for Schools Project
primeStemProgrammes.blurb: Supporting schools with access to technology and digital learning opportunities.
description: The Laptop for Schools Project is an initiative focused on supporting schools with access to digital technology and improving opportunities for technology-enabled learning.

The project recognises the importance of digital access in modern education and seeks to help schools provide learners with the tools needed to participate effectively in an increasingly technology-driven world.
points: Help schools integrate technology into learning.
Support the development of future-ready learners.

services.title: STEM Education & Training
services.description: We create engaging learning experiences that help students understand and apply STEM concepts beyond traditional classroom teaching.
services.longDescription: We design and deliver engaging STEM learning experiences for children, teenagers, schools and organisations — from short workshops to term-long enrichment programmes.

services.title: STEM Competitions
services.description: We organise and support competitions that encourage academic excellence, creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving.
services.longDescription: We support the development and delivery of STEM competitions, exhibitions, workshops and educational events — from school level to pan-African finals.

services.title: STEM Events & Programmes
services.description: From boot camps and workshops to exhibitions and special STEM programmes, we create opportunities for young people to explore and experience STEM.
services.longDescription: We plan and run boot camps, workshops, science fairs, exhibitions, teacher hangouts and special STEM days that bring learning to life.

services.title: STEM Equipment & Educational Products
services.description: We provide STEM equipment, educational kits and learning resources that support practical and hands-on STEM education.
services.longDescription: We can support institutions seeking to establish or improve practical STEM learning environments — from lab equipment to robotics kits and digital learning tools.

services.title: Education Consultancy
services.description: We work with schools and educational organisations to develop and implement effective STEM education initiatives.
services.longDescription: We provide professional guidance to educational institutions and organisations seeking to introduce or strengthen STEM programmes, activities and learning experiences.

services.title: Professional Development
services.description: We create opportunities for educators and STEM professionals to learn, collaborate, mentor and contribute to STEM development.
services.longDescription: We support educators with skills, resources and approaches for effective STEM teaching, and connect STEM professionals with meaningful ways to give back.

whyAfristem.title: Practical Learning
whyAfristem.description: We move STEM beyond theory by creating opportunities for learners to experiment, build, create and solve problems.

whyAfristem.title: Engaging Experiences
whyAfristem.description: We make STEM interesting and relatable, particularly for children and teenagers.

whyAfristem.title: Future-Focused Skills
whyAfristem.description: Our programmes encourage creativity, critical thinking, collaboration, problem-solving and technological literacy.

whyAfristem.title: Inclusive Opportunities
whyAfristem.description: We work to make quality STEM opportunities accessible to learners, schools and communities.

whyAfristem.title: Strong STEM Ecosystem
whyAfristem.description: We connect students, schools, educators, STEM professionals and organisations to create meaningful opportunities.

whyAfristem.title: Innovation
whyAfristem.description: We embrace technology and innovative approaches to improve STEM education.

approach.title: Make STEM Interesting
approach.description: We use engaging activities and experiences to help young people develop a genuine interest in STEM.

approach.title: Make STEM Practical
approach.description: We encourage learning through experimentation, projects, technology and real-world applications.

approach.title: Make STEM Accessible
approach.description: We seek to create opportunities for learners from different backgrounds and communities.

approach.title: Connect People
approach.description: We bring together students, schools, educators, professionals and organisations.

approach.title: Encourage Innovation
approach.description: We encourage learners to move from simply consuming technology to understanding, creating and innovating.

beliefs.title: Every Child Can Innovate
beliefs.description: We believe that every child has the potential to become an innovator.

beliefs.title: STEM Should Be Engaging
beliefs.description: We believe that STEM should not be intimidating or boring.

beliefs.title: Curiosity Drives Learning
beliefs.description: We believe children learn better when they are curious, engaged and given opportunities to experiment.

beliefs.title: Africa's Future Depends on STEM
beliefs.description: We believe Africa's future depends significantly on how effectively we prepare today's young people to understand and create with science and technology.
